accepted.quote: H.R. 276 is an unserious bill that would force federal agencies that in many cases are currently being gutted illegally and without justification to spend time, money, and staffing on renaming the Gulf of Mexico as the ``Gulf of America,'' a symbolic and costly rebranding effort that offers no benefit to the American people.
accepted.rationale: The quote characterizes H.R. 276 as unserious, costly, and without benefit, indicating strong opposition to the renaming proposal.
